change_since_p1.summary: Patch 2 fixes the installer. The release installer checks the signed feed with the Terminal it has just unpacked, and that check remembered the accepted feed sequence in the default component folder (~/.local/share/strata/components). A Mac that already ran upstream Strata keeps a much higher upstream sequence there and refused this fork's feed as a replayed one, installing nothing. Measured on the builder (M1 Ultra, which has upstream sequence 124 remembered): v0.2.14-p1's installer stopped with 'its sequence is 9, the accepted one is 124'; the same installer with the fix, run from the published fork URL into an empty prefix, finished, verified the feed signature and installed engine 0.1.60.1 from the v0.2.14-p1 feed.
files: fork/install.sh: passes STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR=ROOT/components to the release installer, the folder the installed launcher already uses
fork/test_release_tools.py: new test pins that contract without network (fails without the change)
change_since_p1.why_a_new_patch_release: The published v0.2.14-p1 release assets cannot be replaced after publication, so the corrected installer ships as the next patch on the same upstream base. The engine and Control sources are unchanged.

installation_validation.report: INSTALLATION-VALIDATION.json (13 checks, all passed, signed loopback feed on the Apple Silicon builder)
installation_validation.installer_fix_checked_on_the_builder: The fixed fork/install.sh was run from a local copy against the then published v0.2.14-p1 feed into an empty prefix on the M1 Ultra: feed signature verified, Terminal 0.1.60.1 installed, engine 0.1.60.1 downloaded, signature-checked and test-started with --version only. No model was loaded and no server was started. This release's own public URL install is recorded after publication.

environment: Linux (bolder): Python 3.14.4 in a virtualenv outside the repository, Node 24.22.3. macOS ARM (atlas): Darwin 26.6.2, SDK 26.5, Python 3.12.14; the built Terminal reports python 3.12.15 and build 0.1.60.2.
test_temporary_directory: outside Git repositories and outside protected system directories (TMPDIR=/home/hochi/tmp/strata-tests); venv outside the repo (/home/hochi/.cache/venvs/strata-0.2.14-p1)

Installation on a Mac without an existing Strata installation that reaches the public feed (the public run used the builder, which keeps an upstream state; the empty-prefix loopback run covers the fresh case)
limitations: Apple Silicon macOS 15+ only; Intel Macs are not supported by these archives
Historical model measurements are not this release
Optional jsonschema is not bundled; full postvalidation remains optional
Inherited uniqueItems and grammar fallback limitations remain

The docs pages describe upstream's 0.2.14 release, including the frozen dsv41 packages upstream still lists; the fork's own feed carries that entry for older Terminals and ships no DeepSeek engine of its own
The published v0.2.14-p1 release keeps its archive and its own installer; this release supersedes it
